reuse.why: The rule is changed inside the existing shared getExpectedAmount/getWorstCaseAmount helpers that every schedule consumer already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the approximate branch is simplified to a single subtraction of the shared threshold.

placement.why: The change lands in shared/schedules.ts, where the planned-amount rule is defined.

scope.why: Focused on the helper, tests and a release note, but adds unrelated import reorderings in four files.

maintainability.why: A single-point change that is easy to own, though the stale 'furthest from zero' comments in forecast-schedules.ts and the preview code, the now-misleading 'worst case' naming and old test titles were left behind.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; the change goes through getExpectedAmount/getWorstCaseAmount
